title: Plan drafted from three converging threads: dashboard ship + Linear-as-backlog crossover + adapter setup friction
body: Three concerns surfaced during P10 F003 Linear-pick conversation: (1) Dashboard P9-004 F003-F005 has been credential-gated carry-state since 2026-05-09; primary visible-progress surface should ship before broader integration work. (2) If Linear (or any PM tool — Aha, Jira, Monday, GitHub Projects) holds operator's cross-platform plan backlog, DontPanic plan status drifts instantly from PM-tool issue status — crossover with dashboard is real. (3) Adapter setup is 4 manual steps today; if operators want to wire 5+ services each one costs identical friction. Setup bloat real concern. Plan v0 ships 4 features: F001 dashboard close-out (unblocks P9-004), F002 PM-tool category abstraction (Linear becomes reference; new PM tool = config-only), F003 plan ↔ PM-tool sync (linked_issue_id field + close-out push), F004 `dontpanic adapter` CLI (one-command lifecycle). Locked scoping principles: don't pre-build per-service code; Linear is reference not lock-in; dashboard ships first; one-command adapter add; no config bloat in `dontpanic init`. Status:draft awaiting operator review before lock.

title: Non-goals codified for v0 — defer to v1 after real-use signal
body: v0 explicitly defers: (a) PM tool → plan dir scaffolding (Linear issue → `dontpanic plan new` from issue body); (b) multi-tool sync within a single plan (one linked_issue_id per plan, one PM tool per category); (c) adapter capability marketplace / discovery / auto-update UI; (d) mutating endpoints to PM tool beyond status flip; (e) category abstractions for non-PM-tool service categories (incident tracker, observability, docs) — those ship as `--raw` adapters until ≥3 services in a category justify abstraction work. Demand-driven v1 planning per feedback memo: trigger v1 expansion on real-world signal (operator hit limitation N times), not calendar.

title: Sequencing rationale — dashboard first
body: F001 (dashboard ship) is intentionally ordered before F002 (category abstraction) even though F002 has more LLM-dispatchable work. Reason: dashboard is the primary visible surface for operator-level DontPanic state; carry-state since 2026-05-09 is costing operator visibility into orchestrator progress. Also F001 unblocks F003's dashboard-renders-linked-status work. F004 (CLI) ordered last because it's polish on top of F002's category abstraction — wouldn't make sense to ship the CLI before the abstraction it wraps.

title: Scoping principle: no service-specific code in the abstraction layer
body: F002's PM-tool category abstraction MUST stay generic. Linear/Aha/Jira/Monday/GitHub Projects each plug in via ~50-line mapping JSON config. Zero Linear-specific (or Jira-specific) code in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_*.py. If a PM tool has a unique surface that doesn't fit the abstraction (e.g. Jira epics-as-issues, Monday's board concept), the answer is: (a) skip that surface in v0, OR (b) bump the abstraction to cover the new concept generically. Never special-case one tool. This is the primary lock-in mitigator + the primary protection against config bloat — if operator adds 5 PM tools they author 5 small JSONs, not 5 Python wrappers.
